text:
Why does the sky rise so distant?

Why does the earth hang far away?

A strange star trembles there,

shining dimly, steadily.


I do not care to reach the moon,

a circle of monotonous music;

repeating the same tune tirelessly,

far from me, far from my tenderness.


I never look at the scattered fire

of stars, or at the sun's burning road,

but all my heart shapes one desire,

a vain and withered feeling.


For I lie bound beneath the quivering spear;

joy and beauty dance beyond my reach,

I press my heart, I stretch my longing,

and tremblingly I clasp at hope.




"De profundis"

translation.title: De Profundis
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's distance from heaven, beauty, and hope as a bodily ache.
